environment_label: compose (emulators), bounded feasibility only - not capacity evidence (G12)
method: locust headless (isolated uv env, locust pinned in requirements.txt); API = the compose `api` container (profile app, one uvicorn worker) with NS_ADMISSION_ENABLED on and the dev quota file; ingest authenticated as the dev producer; sink = Event Hubs emulator; synthetic events only; latency is per POST (a batch of events)

profile_definition.note: Provisional planning targets from the PRD, measured not guaranteed. The p95 bound has no ingest-specific PRD figure; it reuses the 2 s dashboard planning target as a placeholder.

environment_notes.api: compose api container (profile app), 1 worker, NS_ENV=local
environment_notes.admission_note: Per-domain admission is charged by require() on authenticated read/write routes. The ingest edge authenticates producers separately and keeps its own per-producer limiter, so no request in this run was charged to a domain bucket.
environment_notes.sink: Event Hubs emulator (docker compose), hub 'telemetry', 4 partitions
environment_notes.edge_limiter: product defaults (20 rps per producer, burst 40); ONE dev producer

documented: Event Hubs emulator: one namespace, ten hubs, no persistence, SAS only (no Entra); partition and consumer-group scale cannot be inferred from it.
Cosmos DB vNext emulator: no RU accounting, so no request-unit capacity is measured.
observed_in_this_run: Achieved 120.05 accepted events/s against a 1000.0 events/s target on one single-worker API and one Event Hubs emulator (a ceiling of this setup, not of the product).
No request errors observed at this rate (no 429, 503 or connection failures).
Not observable on the emulator: persistence across restart, partition-count and consumer-group scale, RU accounting, Entra auth.

Admission was enabled on the composed API (NS_ADMISSION_ENABLED=true, NS_ADMISSION_POLICY_FILE=/etc/neurosphere/admission-quotas.json) but ingest routes are not charged by it; per-domain admitted/throttled counts on authenticated routes are OPEN (they need an Entra token against the real stack).

open: G07 stays OPEN: this run is bounded feasibility on emulators, not capacity evidence.
Enterprise and stress profiles are operator-run at a sized environment (not run).
